problemSignature.symptom: KiCad Python exact-finisher helper can hang while evaluating local DRC-repair candidates

rootCause: The exact ratsnest finisher evaluated many physical route candidates inside one KiCad Python process, so a single pathological candidate or DRC call could stall the entire finishing pass.
fixSummary: Run each exact-finisher candidate in its own KiCad Python subprocess with parent-side timeouts and parent-side promotion DRC. Timed-out or unsafe candidates are rolled back individually while the parent continues to the next candidate.

testsAdded: exact finisher isolates each physical candidate in parent-supervised subprocesses

conditions: candidate DRC can hang or time out

recipe: Start from a clean DRC board with remaining KiCad unconnected items.
Enumerate exact route candidates in a child KiCad Python process.
Apply only one candidate per child process.
Terminate the child if it exceeds candidate-timeout-ms.
Run promotion DRC from the parent process.
Commit only when shorts and forbidden vias remain zero, DRC remains clean, and unconnected count decreases.
Rollback timed-out, unsafe, or non-improving candidates and continue.
safetyRules: Do not change footprints, packages, parts, pads, or nets.
Do not use blind, buried, micro, or via-in-pad vias.
Do not promote candidates that introduce shorts, forbidden vias, or non-connectivity DRC.

before.behavior: monolithic helper could stall during targeted exact-finisher local repair attempts

after.behavior: each candidate is bounded by a parent-supervised subprocess timeout and promotion gate
